claims.quote: **C1. Presence.** In every slice of a persisting line, the Unit and the witness are present in full: not as a fragment but whole, and the same throughout the line. *Imported, in declared classes, each for its own part:* the Unit on the active line (*The Crown*, §§5–6); the witness, whose period stays constant across windows when every transition of a switching schedule is tunnelled (*Identity Does Not Drift*, Lemma 4.2); an exactly constant identity coordinate in the separated state architecture (*The Physics of Abstraction*, Theorem 7.1). These are class-relative conventions and conditional preservation results, each with its own correspondence obligations; they do not by themselves certify an arbitrary realised system.

claims.kind: two proved particular cases for declared classes; for the shells no result is asserted
claims.quote: **C2. Visibility.** The boundary in the declaration record is readable by construction. This convention is distinct from the substantive question: does the selected slice decide transformation under load and continuation through the irreversible? Two particular answers are proved for declared classes. On the class A,B,A of *The Physics of Abstraction*, §3.2, the verdict that every seam is preserved does not factor through the last visible symbol together with the fixed preservation rule: the histories with labels (0,0) and (1,−1) share that reading, and even the sum of their labels, yet their verdicts differ. A second, distinct limitation concerns an open future. In *Mirrors of Whole Trajectories*, M11, the verdict that exactly N unit-cost events are eventually spent, N≥1, is not decided by any fixed finite prefix, nor by any observation that is a function of that prefix. The complete observed past is the same in the separating pair. This is future underdetermination on that class, not loss of past information by a compressed slice, and not a failure to decide whether a next continuation is currently allowed. For the shells of *The Crown*, the observation and the target must be fixed separately. Generator-relative openness factors through the line's activity and attained edge under the declared model (§§5–6). The crown term is defined only where that openness verdict is true. Preservation in a specified realised transition is evaluated from the declared identity history, realised family and continuer; the transition record of §15 supplies these data. Neither this record nor the full Crown state should be identified with the pair ⟨Unit, attained edge⟩. A verdict about which continuation will actually occur is a further question. For a specified restricted observation V, non-factorisation requires two histories of the same independently declared class with equal V and different target verdicts. No such result for the full shell model is asserted here; the question for the shells remains open. The class must be specified by its dynamics and input conditions, not by requiring the desired absence of a decoder (O2).

**C3. Certification.** A slice certifies identity exactly when its observation fibre is homogeneous (*The Physics of Abstraction*, Theorem 3.1). A slice together with its membership word certifies the declared identity verdict, provided the instrument is persistence-complete (*The Physics of Abstraction*, Corollary 5.5). So a point can certify identity when it gathers the record of its own path into itself. The complete membership record is a sufficient construction, not the only one: a compressed key also works if the declared verdict factors through it (C4). *A consequence of imported results; what is new is the reading “gathering = slice + membership record” as a sufficient construction.* Architectural constraint, after *The Physics of Abstraction*, §5.2, where the record may be retained by a non-causal audit: here it is held by such an audit, outside the optimization surface of the acting agent. The holder of this record, the external witness, is not the one who acts.

**C4. Gathering and collapse.** For a declared pair (observation map V, verdict Q), a map from lines to points permits exact reading of Q if and only if its fibres are homogeneous for Q; a collapse relative to this pair is exactly a mixed fibre. When Q is an identity verdict, this is a criterion of certification, not a separate proof of physical preservation under transport. *The criterion is imported* (*The Physics of Abstraction*, Theorem 3.1; *The Double Fibre of Verification*: Q = q∘V if and only if Q is constant on the fibres of V). *New: the place of the criterion in the distinction between a record's temporal scope and its sufficiency.*

If only a predeclared nonempty set of cycles \(W_0\) with \(a(\gamma)\ne0\) is tested, use the reading domain \(W_0\cup\{0\}\). The same criterion is equivalent to preservation on \(W_0\): every nonzero fibre is already homogeneous, while the zero fibre is mixed exactly when at least one selected pairing is lost. Without the zero cycle the verdict would be constantly one and the test would distinguish nothing. This restricted criterion does not establish proportionality on all of \(E\). The domain matters even for an infinite set: \(a(x,y)=x\) and \(r(x,y)=x+\sqrt2y\) preserve every nonzero original pairing on \(\mathbb Z^2\), because \(r\) has no nonzero integral kernel vector, yet \(r(-\sqrt2,1)=0\) and \(a(-\sqrt2,1)\ne0\) on \(\mathbb R^2\). The irrational example belongs to the real-coefficient extension and not to the integral or common-denominator rational witness class of *Identity Does Not Drift*, Proposition 5.1. If \(r\) is rational on a full lattice \(\Lambda\) spanning \(E\), its lattice kernel spans its real kernel: a rational basis of \(\ker r\) can be multiplied by denominators to lie in \(\Lambda\). Hence \(\ker r\cap\Lambda\subseteq\ker a\cap\Lambda\) is equivalent to \(\ker r\subseteq\ker a\). This equivalence requires the whole lattice; restriction to a selected set of recurrent classes can still be weaker, even for rational data.

A collapse for this pair \((r,Q)\) occurs when a cycle with nonzero original pairing enters the kernel of the transported pairing and shares the zero reading with the zero cycle. This can occur under partial preservation as well as annihilation of all the declared witness-bearing pairings (*Spin-Channel Bridge and Core-Reduction*, Proposition 4.3); reduction through a contractible core is a canonical annihilating case (*ONTOΣ XV*, Structural Statement XV.3). A retained complete record of that transition can be a gathering for a different verdict, such as “the witness was lost”. It does not turn the destructive transport itself into a preserving one. *Imported: the transport regimes of the XV companion; new: their explicit connection to C4 for the named map, verdict and domain.*

This thought has a short mathematical support [K3t]. In a declared model, a transition followed by its inverse returns the selected state exactly. If each of the two steps costs \(\varepsilon>0\) on the same bearer and in the same non-resetting burden account, the account after the return reads \(b+2\varepsilon\), rather than the earlier \(b\). With finite capacity, the inverse step must still be affordable. This is a conditional model, not a measurement of a warrior's life or a certificate of his identity. It poses a precise question: which parts of a journey can be reversed, and which must be carried onward even after returning.

limits: Exact manuscript bytes and locator identity only; quotations do not prove the interpretation.
Finite families and rational countermodels do not prove universal or empirical claims.
A family with the role supporting apparatus names the results whose finite checks rest on it; it does not cover them.
M3/M5 periodic witnesses are illustrations, not an exhaustive topology or the complete smooth construction.
M4 has no numerical smooth-model test here; the unchanged Lean record and M-L10 state its formal coverage and exclusions.
M12 delayed examples do not exhaust arbitrary admissibility predicates.
M15 infinite convergence and M16 eventual exhaustion retain their analytic proof obligations.

C1 imported results are not established by these finite examples. Of C2, the finite checks instantiate the two proved particular cases (A,B,A in the Warrior companion, M11 in deep/M10); for the shells of The Crown no result is asserted.
N1 through N6 remain hypotheses about declared physical systems; finite countermodels constrain their interpretation.
Dependency extraction from prose and completeness of the declared graph remain human review obligations.
No V3 internals or physical Operator Zero are tested.
This release binds the three English manuscripts only. Russian translation-source anchors are excluded; they remain in the historical source index.
Claims of the other works are pinned by path, line and SHA-256 of the quoted span; their text is not carried in this package.
